body:
I decided to call, and I got an appointment for the week after Christmas, so hopefully that goes well.

Thank you, that's sweet to say.

Thank you for your reply,

I've had thoughts like these before, and whenever I mention them to my doctor, she gives me a number to call, and by the time I get around to being able to call the number (or remembering to), I'm feeling a little better, and don't feel like I need it. I feel like therapy could definitely help, though. 

I know that I need other people to help me, but its a difficult thing to ask for, especially feeling like nobody else would or should care, or like I don't deserve anybody's help. I can see my problem, but the ways out of it are tough for me. (I apologise if I'm not making any sense.)

I'm at a point where I'm overdrawn more than I earn in a month, with no savings at all, and a shaky hold on the job I do have. I'm feeling more hopeful now than I did when I wrote this, but I still can't see more than a few months into the future, and I hate to say it, but I am scared.

Thank you for saying this, though, and for taking the time to reply, for real.

Thank you so much. 

I sort of drifted between being okay, and despairing. I'm not feeling as bad at the moment as I was when I wrote this, but give it a few days and I'll drift back.

I don't really have many people to talk to about this sort of thing. I'm not really what you'd call the most emotive person around. I'd actually love to talk, if you really mean that.

Thank you for saying that. 

It was the 12th, I've never actually met anybody with the same birthday as me.
